description_en: Queries the configuration information of nodes in a Tair (Redis OSS-compatible) cluster instance, such as the specifications and the maximum number of connections
description_zh: 查询云数据库 Tair（兼容 Redis）集群实例的节点配置信息（例如规格、最大连接数等）
name: DescribeClusterMemberInfo

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Tair (Redis OSS-compatible) instance. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473778.html operation to query instance IDs
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values: 30, 50, and 100. Default value: 30
parameters.help_zh: 每页可展示的最大记录数，取值：30、50、100，默认值为30
parameters.name: page_size

ClusterChildren.description_en: Details about data nodes in the cluster instance
ClusterChildren.description_zh: 集群实例的数据节点信息列表

BandWidth.description_en:
The maximum bandwidth of the node. Unit: MB/s.

This parameter is returned only if the return value of Service is redis, which indicates a data node
BandWidth.description_zh:
节点的带宽，单位为MB/s。
当Service返回值为redis（即节点类型为数据节点）时，才会返回本参数

BizType.description_en: The type of workload. The return value is ALIYUN
BizType.description_zh: 业务类型，返回值固定为ALIYUN

Capacity.description_en:
The maximum memory capacity per data node. Unit: MB.

This parameter is returned only if the return value of Service is redis, which indicates a data node
Capacity.description_zh:
单个数据节点的最大内存容量，单位为MB。
当Service返回值为redis（即节点类型为数据节点）时，才会返回本参数

ClassCode.description_en: The specifications of the data node. For more information, see [Community Edition instances that use cloud disks]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/164477.html）
ClassCode.description_zh: 数据节点的规格。更多信息，请参见[云原生版实例规格]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/164477.html）

Connections.description_en: The maximum number of connections supported by the data node
Connections.description_zh: 数据节点的最大连接数

CurrentBandWidth.description_en: The current bandwidth of the data node, which is the sum of the default bandwidth and any extra bandwidth that is purchased. Unit: Mbit/s
CurrentBandWidth.description_zh:
节点当前的带宽，单位为MB/s，由节点的默认带宽和增加的带宽组成。

<props="china">当实例通过专属集群创建时，才会返回本参数。</props>

DiskSizeMB.description_en:
The storage capacity of the [enhanced SSD (ESSD)]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/122389.html） that is used by the data node. Unit: MB.

The ESSD is used only to store system operating data, such as Persistent Memory (PMEM). It is not used as a medium to write and read data
DiskSizeMB.description_zh:
数据节点[ESSD云盘]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/122389.html）的存储空间，单位为MB。
该ESSD云盘仅用作系统运行使用（例如数据持久化），不作为数据存取的介质

Id.description_en: The ID of the replica set in the node

Name.description_en: The name of the data node

ResourceGroupName.description_en: The name of the resource group to which the node belongs
ResourceGroupName.description_zh: 节点所属的资源组名称

Service.description_en:
The node type. Valid values:

redis: data node
redis_cs: config server
Service.description_zh:
节点类型，返回值：
redis：数据节点。
redis_cs：配置服务器节点

ServiceVersion.description_en: The major version of the node
